description: AG-8 tool/generation-path selection corpus: each case runs the real live path (aida.agent_intelligence.GovernedRetriever.retrieve then aida.agent_intelligence.GovernedPlanner.plan -- the same objects the live orchestrator, agent_orchestrator.GovernedAgentOrchestrator, calls) against the seeded catalog and checks the resulting AgentPlan.strategy. This is the deterministic half of 'model/generation quality': whether the governed planner picks the approved tool, falls through to (simulated) controlled SQL, or requires model generation -- none of which needs a live model route to measure honestly, because tool-first selection happens entirely inside the deterministic planner (module 13's PLANNED state), before GENERATED. True generated-text quality is a separate, model-route-gated section of scripts/quality_benchmark.py (see its ModelGenerationPosture reporting) and is NOT covered by this corpus.
